decisions.reason: The comfort insole builds on the firm’s foot-measurement and footwear comfort knowledge, allowing it to interpret feedback and improve without high drop risk.

Although supportive insoles require more specialised orthotic knowledge, the firm’s foot-measurement tools and in-house specialists let it assimilate feedback and adjust, keeping withdrawal risk moderate.
The ergonomic safety shoe series directly extends the firm’s core safety footwear capabilities and, with its dedicated webpage, signals strong internal commitment and very low drop likelihood.

Firefighter and rescue boots are adjacent but require new certification and high-performance material knowledge; the firm can build absorptive capacity through its R&D, so it is likely kept with moderate uncertainty.
As the moulded insole is the stated flagship shown on the home page, the firm will continue investing in the related production and design knowledge, making withdrawal very unlikely.
